name: bad-time
description: Opens Bad Time Simulator (by Jcw87) in its own window while Claude works. Not affiliated with Undertale or Toby Fox.

onFinish.title: When Claude finishes
onFinish.description: close: the window closes a few seconds after Claude answers and opens fresh on your next prompt. keep: it stays open between prompts.

delaySeconds.title: Delay before opening
delaySeconds.description: Seconds Claude must be working before the window opens. Shorter turns never open it.

countdownSeconds.title: Countdown before closing
countdownSeconds.description: Seconds between the chime and the window closing after Claude answers (onFinish = close).

sounds.title: Chime
sounds.description: A short chime when Claude needs you or finishes while the game is open.

strayKeyGuard.title: Stray-key guard
strayKeyGuard.description: Holds a prompt sent within 1.5 s of the mod closing the window, so game keys never send one by accident.

windowSize.title: Window size
windowSize.description: auto (centered, about 60% of the screen height), or WIDTHxHEIGHT such as 900x700. The window is resizable either way.

browserPath.title: Browser path
browserPath.description: Full path to Chrome, Edge, Chromium or Brave. Leave empty to find one.

url.title: Game URL
url.description: Must be https. Point it at a mirror if the original page is down.
